summary: Grouped-board port in progress. The ordinary Rust viewer seeds two Work groups with distinct accepted colours and duplicate Review roots, plus an empty Reserve with a custom colour. The compared workflow is to change one group's colour, cancel or save explicitly, then move and reload it without changing its peer. Live packet acceptance remains pending.
evidence: Final locked wasm32 check of boardcraft-web passed after fixing a moved EditError. The modified web_board_view example passed cargo check. Locked boardcraft-web and boardcraft-ui tests passed (6/6): two production-table Kit interactions (edit the second duplicate and cancel; fold while preserving a hidden selection anchor), three gesture-state cases, and a focused Escape/subsequent drag Kit example.

All 42 cases passed in the locked loopback_board_access integration suite on the disposable PostgreSQL database (0 failed, ignored or filtered). Cases include grouped ordering, edit revisions, atomic selection moves, folds, archive/Trash receipts, denial and rollback.
Runner status reports packets 53 and 54 verified and 55 pending. The owner's visual check covers the previous build.

Source comparison identified separate roles for the saved group colour (name and rail), selection, keyboard focus, muted count and the heading/row drop marker. This specifies visible expectations; it does not establish a rendered colour match.

After the owner removed viewer authentication for the port, the disposable viewer launched the seeded board in the default browser. Computer Use verified fresh entry and a Chrome reload without credentials: blue Work (1 item), green Work (2 items), Reserve (No items), and the board editing controls were visible. No identity picker or sign-in form appeared.

The focused disposable_viewer_opens_review_on_independent_visits host integration test passed: independent credential-free visits, persisted edit ownership, and isolation from the two ordinary host modes.
next: When grouped-board proofing resumes, compare the second Work's colour before Cancel, after Save and after reorder/reload.
